overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the censure, the off-notice discussion of the complainant, whispering, and chair's phone use, and declined to review the document-reading, out-of-order, and phone-policy allegations.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the board voted to censure two members without the censure vote or related discussion appearing on the June 25 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: For the same reasons, we also find that the Planning Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it censured Mr. Grant and Ms. Wilder.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the board discussed him and his emails about the zoning bylaw without listing that discussion as a topic on the June 25 notice.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Planning Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing the complainant, Mr. Grant, and Ms. Wilder, as to the Overlay District.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged members engaged in side bars and whispering during the June 25 meeting, which he said amounted to improper deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no whispering or electronic communication that reached a quorum of the Planning Board, there was no improper deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair used her electronic device during the June 25 meeting, which he said was improper.
allegations.key_passage: Similarly, Chair Melanson can be seen using her phone at points during the meeting but there is no evidence that the phone was used to communicate with a quorum of the members.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a member read documents aloud, including a legal opinion from his phone, without giving copies to others or entering them into the record.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review allegations that the Planning Board read documents without providing copies or entering them into the public record.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged agenda items were discussed out of the order listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Similarly, we decline to review the allegation that items on the meeting agenda were discussed out of order.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged members should not use their phones during a meeting at all.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that the complainant alleges that members of a public body should not use their phones during a meeting at all, we decline to review this allegation as well.
